overview.summary: End-to-end lifecycle of a POS order from creation to terminal state (completed, cancelled, or refunded). Each workflow maps to one or more API calls and a state machine transition.

workflows.name: Order Creation + Item Addition
workflows.trigger: Cashier starts a new customer sale

steps.result: Order created, status=pending, orderNumber assigned, totalVnd=0
OrderItem created with price+tax snapshot. totalVnd recalculated.

steps.action: Repeat step 2 for each product in cart
steps.result: All line items added, totalVnd reflects full cart

steps.action: Optional: DELETE /api/v1/orders/:id/items/:itemId  OR  POST with quantity=0 to remove

failure_paths.response: 409 — order is locked, no items can be added

postconditions: Order in 'pending' state with N items and correct totalVnd

steps.result: UI shows invoice number to cashier and customer

failure_paths.response: Order stays in 'processing'. Retry up to 3x with exponential backoff. If all fail, order moves to 'cancelled' and error logged.

workflows.name: Order Cancellation
workflows.trigger: Customer changes mind OR cashier error before payment

steps.action: No invoice is generated (order never reached 'processing')
steps.result: No side effects on invoice system

failure_paths.response: 409 — cannot cancel after payment confirmed. Use refund flow instead.

postconditions: Order status=cancelled (terminal). Order data retained for audit.

workflows.name: Refund Flow (Sprint 4 stub)
workflows.trigger: Accountant or manager approves a refund request for a completed order
workflows.status: stub — full implementation deferred to Sprint 4

steps.result: Order status → refunded. Triggers InvoiceModule to cancel associated invoice.

postconditions: Order status=refunded. Invoice status=cancelled. Both retained for audit.

data_scoping_contract.rule: EVERY order query MUST filter by storeId derived from JWT request.user.storeId
data_scoping_contract.anti_pattern: NEVER filter by storeId from URL params or request body
